_note: Synthetic policy corpus for a fictional company (Kestrel Logistics). Written for this example; not a real policy.

passages.title: Travel policy v2: hotels
passages.text: Travel policy version 2. The nightly hotel cap for domestic business trips is 150 EUR per night, including capital cities.

passages.title: Travel policy v3: hotels
passages.text: Travel policy version 3. The nightly hotel cap for domestic business trips is 180 EUR per night. For trips to a capital city the nightly cap is 220 EUR.

passages.title: Partner hotel discounts
passages.text: Partner hotels in most cities offer employees a discount when the stay is booked through the travel portal for a business trip.

passages.title: Meals and per diem
passages.text: The meal allowance is 45 EUR for each full travel day. Alcoholic drinks are never reimbursable, including at client meals.

passages.title: Client entertainment
passages.text: Hosting a client lunch or dinner requires prior approval from a budget holder. The limit is 60 EUR per attendee.

passages.title: Home office equipment
passages.text: Employees may buy home office equipment such as a monitor or chair up to 300 EUR every 36 months. Manager approval is required before the purchase.

passages.title: Training budget
passages.text: The annual training budget is 1200 EUR and covers course and conference registration fees. Flights, trains and hotels for a conference are reimbursed under the travel policy and are not charged to the training budget.

passages.title: Rail travel
passages.text: First class rail tickets are allowed when the train journey is longer than 4 hours. Shorter journeys are booked in second class.

passages.title: Gifts from suppliers
passages.text: Gifts from a supplier worth up to 50 EUR may be accepted and must be recorded in the gifts register. Cash or vouchers are never accepted.
